reason: The full startup glyph customization path is live on the initial map but unported. Work remains across optfn_glyph parsing, generated concrete and symbolic catalogs, custom Unicode/color state, symbol-set ownership, object shuffle ordering, and application to every reachable glyph range.

boundary.startingEvent: Startup parseoptions() dispatches a glyph compound option from OPTIONS in the player configuration.
boundary.endingEvent: initoptions_finish and moveloop preparation have installed and applied every customization, and the first complete map and next command boundary have been captured.
boundary.validInputs: Concrete G_* glyph identifiers; S_* cmap, object-class, and monster-class identifiers; selected default or rogue symbol sets; Unicode and enhanced/named color specifications; duplicates, malformed values, negation, and source ordering within the recorder build.
boundary.observables: Configuration diagnostics and waits; installed option, symbol-set, and custom-map state; PRNG calls including object description shuffling; complete 24x80 screens with attributes; cursors; and the first input boundary.
boundary.exclusions: Interactive option editing, later glyph changes, GUI rendering, WIZKIT, MENUCOLOR, and SYMBOLS=G_* application remain outside the boundary. SYMBOLS validation/serialization without application is an explicit control. optionsfull retains the source '(to be done)' getter result.

candidateListMethod.upstreamEntryPoints: options.c optfn_glyph; glyphs.c glyphrep_to_custom_map_entries, glyph_find_core, parse_id, add_custom_urep_entry, add_custom_nhcolor_entry, and apply_customizations; initoptions_finish and the moveloop pending-customization path.
candidateListMethod.dispatchTablesAndCatalogs: optlist.h glyph row, generated glyph identifiers and ranges, cmap symbol catalogs, object classes, monster classes, primary/rogue symbol-set state, enhanced color names, and object description index tables.
candidateListMethod.reachableHelpers: Trace every parse and expansion branch from optfn_glyph through queued custom entries, reset_glyphmap/application, and the first display; include diagnostics, replacement, ordering, and object-shuffle dependencies before map output.
candidateListMethod.javascriptCrossCheck: Search options.js, symbols.js, display.js, allmain.js, generated glyph/symbol data, and explicit unported refusals for raw glyph retention, duplicate state owners, skipped ranges, and before-effect boundaries.
candidateListMethod.remainingLimits: The catalog and full application ranges still require source review. Fresh strict witnesses currently prove only one concrete G_* hero glyph and one S_human class expansion; passing those samples is not completeness evidence.

entries.reachability: OPTIONS=glyph reaches the compound handler during startup, including missing, empty, negated, malformed, and duplicate values.
entries.effects: Reports exact source diagnostics, preserves or replaces queued state in source order, and leaves the source getter placeholder visible.
entries.evidence: options.c optfn_glyph and a fresh pre-slice malformed-row divergence.
entries.remaining: Port the complete startup do_set/get_val behavior and pin duplicate and later-line precedence.

entries.reachability: A case-sensitive G_ prefix selects one generated concrete glyph id, with case-insensitive lookup of the remaining source name.
entries.effects: Queues Unicode and/or color customization for exactly one concrete glyph.
entries.evidence: Fresh seed 940101 reaches G_male_healer on the first map with exact PRNG/cursor counts and a hero-cell attribute mismatch.
entries.remaining: Generate the full source catalog and implement exact lookup, bounds, and error behavior.

entries.reachability: An S_ identifier naming a cmap symbol expands through every concrete glyph range represented by that symbol.
entries.effects: Queues source-ordered customization entries for all matching cmap glyphs in the selected symbol-set context.
entries.evidence: glyphs.c symbolic expansion branches; S_room is a non-discriminating Unicode-to-Unicode recorder control and cannot stand alone as proof.
entries.remaining: Port the complete cmap fan-out and validate a source-visible discriminator plus range-state assertions.

entries.reachability: An S_ identifier naming an object class expands over every matching object glyph, including description-index-sensitive objects.
entries.effects: Queues customization records whose application must follow the recorder's shuffled object description indexes.
entries.evidence: glyphs.c object-class branch and moveloop pending_customizations ordering.
entries.remaining: Trace and port the full class fan-out and prove ordering around object description shuffling.

entries.reachability: An S_ identifier naming a monster class expands over every matching monster glyph and sex/form variant in the generated ranges.
entries.effects: Queues customization for every source-selected monster glyph before first display.
entries.evidence: glyphs.c monster-class branch; fresh seed 940105 S_human is a strict initial-map discriminator.
entries.remaining: Port the complete generated-range fan-out and validate representative class state and screen effects.

entries.reachability: Glyph names and S_* expansion resolve against gs.symset_which_set and the last loaded primary or rogue symbol set, including unnamed/default and failed named selection.
entries.effects: Selects the correct base symbols, handling flags, colors, and diagnostics without creating a duplicate owner.
entries.evidence: symbols.c symbol-set state and glyphs.c selected-set branches.
entries.remaining: Trace default, named, missing, and rogue-set cases through queued customization and application.

entries.reachability: A valid U+ codepoint suffix creates or replaces a custom Unicode representation entry for each selected glyph.
entries.effects: Stores source-shaped codepoint and representation metadata and changes the first map character/attributes where visible.
entries.evidence: glyphs.c add_custom_urep_entry and strict U+2603 fresh witnesses.
entries.remaining: Port validation, replacement, ordering, reset, and application for valid and malformed Unicode forms.

entries.candidate: Enhanced, named, RGB, and black-marker color records
entries.reachability: A glyph value supplies an enhanced color name or RGB triple, including the source marker that distinguishes explicit black/default handling.
entries.effects: Stores source-shaped custom color state and changes glyph attributes without changing unrelated symbol state.
entries.evidence: glyphs.c add_custom_nhcolor_entry and coloratt.c enhanced color parsing; strict fresh RGB witnesses.
entries.remaining: Port every accepted color family, rejection, marker, replacement, and canonical value.

entries.reachability: Several glyph rows or S_* fan-outs target the same concrete glyph within one line or across later lines.
entries.effects: Source list insertion/replacement order determines the final Unicode/color state before application.
entries.evidence: glyphs.c add_custom_* and apply_customizations list traversal.
entries.remaining: Pin right-to-left parse order, later-line order, and independent Unicode/color replacement.

entries.candidate: Application across every concrete glyph range
entries.reachability: initoptions_finish resets the glyph map and applies queued entries before the first display.
entries.effects: Updates every source range and preserves defaults for untouched glyphs, producing exact map characters and attributes.
entries.remaining: Inventory all generated ranges and validate state plus complete first-map output, not only hero cells.

entries.candidate: Pending customization and object shuffle order
entries.reachability: Object description indexes are randomized during startup before pending glyph customizations that depend on them are installed.
entries.effects: Preserves source PRNG order and maps object-class customizations to the post-shuffle description indexes.
entries.evidence: allmain.c pending_customizations path and objects oc_descr_idx initialization.
entries.remaining: Port the exact lifecycle hook and validate PRNG logs and object customization state through first command.

entries.candidate: Getter, config formatter, and optionsfull boundary
entries.reachability: The configured glyph row is queried by existing option display/config formatting paths.
entries.effects: Matches the source '(to be done)' get_val behavior and does not falsely claim interactive editing or serialization support.
entries.evidence: options.c optfn_glyph getter branch and TTY capability filtering.
entries.remaining: Pin the exact source placeholder and named before-effect exclusions.

entries.reachability: A SYMBOLS row can name G_* syntax through the symbol parser, but this boundary does not make it an OPTIONS=glyph customization.
entries.effects: Validates or retains source symbol-set metadata without changing the first map through the glyph customization list.
entries.evidence: symbols.c parser versus options.c optfn_glyph dispatch separation.
entries.remaining: Trace the exact nonapplication contract and add a fresh or focused control.

sourceReview: Incomplete. The selector traced optfn_glyph, glyphrep_to_custom_map_entries, glyph_find_core, parse_id, custom Unicode/color entry creation, initoptions_finish, and the pending-customization hook sufficiently to prove the boundary and strict G_* and S_* witnesses. The worker must still enumerate every generated glyph range and every valid input family, confirm source list and replacement semantics, and identify all JavaScript stops or duplicate owners before readiness.
